welcome.heading: Welcome to Busarialao College.
welcome.text: We began in 2003 as Top Tutors, a small tutorial centre, and became a college in 2005 with 12 pioneer students and one idea: that science should come alive. Today we are a pure science school [CONFIRM], with laboratories, small classes and staff who expect the best of every student.

science.heading: A pure science school, built to push past limits.
science.lead: A pure science college from JSS1 to SS3, and the first and only of its kind [CONFIRM].

science.examsText: In-house certification exams for all learners, and preparatory exams for JSS3 and SSS3 before the external exams, set through Top Tutors.
